page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening). Running head at top with page number 67 at upper right. Main text in two columns of paragradigm-style Greek verb forms: a central column of Greek forms with Latin glosses in a narrow right-hand column of notes; a full-width paragraph of Latin text below; a catchword-like signature mark at foot. Marginal notes at the right beside the forms and one note "Notio." beside the paragraph.

Futurum ϛ.
Paulopost.fut.
main_text.p: Sicut participia praeterita Actiuorũ Notio. à Latinis paraphrastice redduntur, ita hic circūscribitur praesens, ὁ τυπτόμενος, qui caeditur uel caedebatur: uel mutato tempore, percussus.

page.notes: Greek forms and Latin glosses in the central and right columns are set in parallel; the glosses "Verberā tus", "Mox uerberandus" etc. are split across lines as printed. Bottom signature mark "€ 2" printed at foot of text. Some Greek accents and breathings are approximate.
